0.name: Average / Balanced Customers
0.description: Middle-class income bracket with moderate, steady purchasing behavior. Represents the bulk of everyday steady revenue.
0.strategy: Retain with seasonal promotions, cross-selling popular bestsellers, standard membership perks, and personalized recommendations.

1.name: High-Value / Premium Customers
1.description: High income earners who actively spend. Loyal, brand-conscious, and value premium quality over discounts.
1.strategy: Target with VIP loyalty rewards, exclusive early access to product launches, personalized concierge service, and premium experiences.

2.name: Potential / Aspirational Spenders
2.description: Lower to moderate income earners with very high shopping enthusiasm. Tend to be trend-driven and impulsive buyers.
2.strategy: Offer flexible installment/EMI plans (BNPL), trendy micro-deals, engaging flash sales, and rewards programs to build sustainable loyalty.

3.name: Cautious Savers / Frugal Affluent
3.description: Substantial income but very disciplined expenditure. Cautious decision makers who calculate ROI before buying.
3.strategy: Send value-focused promotional campaigns, emphasize durability and warranties, provide member-only high-tier cashbacks, and highlight investment value.

4.name: Budget / Low-Spending Customers
4.description: Modest financial capacity with strictly restricted purchasing habits. Highly price-sensitive.
4.strategy: Promote clearance discounts, bundle bargains, coupon codes, and essential everyday items with lowest price guarantees.
